results.title: Qumulo Turns Long-Term Archives Into a Searchable, AI-Ready Asset at Archive-Tier Cost
results.description: SAN FRANCISCO--(BUSINESS WIRE)--At Microsoft Ignite today, Qumulo introduced ANQ Frozen, a new tier for Azure Native Qumulo (ANQ) that stores data at offline archive-tier cost while keeping every file pathway discoverable, searchable, and retrievable. It gives organizations a modern alternative to tape for data they must keep for years or decades. results.title: ZenaTech Inc. (NASDAQ: ZENA) Is ‘One to Watch’
results.description: ZenaTech (NASDAQ: ZENA) is a technology company developing AI-autonomous drone platforms and services for commercial, government, and defense customers. Its portfolio combines aerial technology with enterprise software to help organizations improve mission-critical operations through automation, precision, and more useful operational data.

results.title: Makerverse launches pan-African platform to improve music royalty payments
results.description: Music technology company Makerverse has launched a platform aimed at helping independent artists, record labels and distributors across Africa distribute music globally and receive royalties through local bank accounts.
